 customers.name AS dimension_0, sales_representatives.name AS dimension_1, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS measure_value FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id INNER JOIN sales_representatives ON orders.sales_rep_id = sales_representatives.id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY customers.name, sales_representatives.name ORDER BY dimension_0), denominator AS (SELECT customers.name AS dimension_0, sales_representatives.name AS dimension_1, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS measure_value FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id INNER JOIN sales_representatives ON orders.sales_rep_id = sales_representatives.id GROUP BY customers.name, sales_representatives.name ORDER BY dimension_0) SELECT COALESCE(numerator.dimension_0, denominator.dimension_0) AS dimension_0, COALESCE(numerator.dimension_1, denominator.dimension_1) AS dimension_1, CASE WHEN COALESCE(denominator.measure_value, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COALESCE(numerator.measure_value, 0) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COALESCE(denominator.measure_value, 0) AS DECIMAL) * 100 END AS metric_value FROM numerator FULL OUTER JOIN denominator ON numerator.dimension_0 = denominator.dimension_0 AND numerator.dimension_1 = denominator.dimension_1 ORDER BY dimension_0

cases.question: Which customer names and region identifiers are recorded in the customer source?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, c.region_id FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: Show product labels together with their catalog categories.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: List order numbers alongside the currency stored for each order.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.currency FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Return payment identifiers and their recorded statuses.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.status FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: Show refund identifiers with their stated reasons.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.reason FROM refunds AS r ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: List sales representative names with their region identifiers.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.name, sr.region_id FROM sales_representatives AS sr ORDER BY sr.name

cases.question: Show line-item identifiers and the referenced product identifiers.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT oi.id, oi.product_id FROM order_items AS oi ORDER BY oi.id

cases.question: Return region names with their stable identifiers.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name FROM regions AS r ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: List order numbers and their discount amounts.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.discount_amount FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show customer names and their assigned representatives.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, c.sales_rep_id FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: At customer grain, show each customer and the total value of their orders.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS order_total FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: At product grain, total the quantities recorded on its order lines.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: For each representative, count the orders assigned to that representative.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.id, sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sr.name

cases.question: Report payment totals at order grain.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_number, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.order_number ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: For every region, count its customers through the region relationship.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name, COUNT(c.id) AS customer_count FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name

cases.question: At order grain, total the refund amount associated with each order.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_number, SUM(r.amount) AS refund_total FROM orders AS o JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.order_number ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show each product category and its joined line-item quantity.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: List representatives and the names of their regions.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.name AS representative, r.name AS region FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN regions AS r ON r.id = sr.region_id ORDER BY sr.name

cases.question: For each customer, show the number of distinct products in their orders.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: At region grain, sum payment amounts reached through customers and orders.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name

cases.question: Give the minimum, maximum, and average order total for every status.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.status, MIN(o.total_amount) AS minimum_total, MAX(o.total_amount) AS maximum_total, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_total FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

cases.question: Summarize payment amount by currency, including its count.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.currency, COUNT(p.id) AS payment_count, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM orders AS o JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency

cases.question: For each product category, calculate its average and total listed price.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average_price, SUM(p.unit_price) AS total_price FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: Count refunds and total their amounts by reason.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.reason, COUNT(r.id) AS refund_count, SUM(r.amount) AS refund_total FROM refunds AS r GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY r.reason

cases.question: Show order count and subtotal sum for each sales representative.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.subtotal) AS subtotal_total FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sr.name

cases.question: Group line items by product and calculate total quantity and line value.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_total, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_value FROM order_items AS oi GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY oi.product_id

cases.question: For each order currency, report average discount and average subtotal.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.currency, AVG(o.discount_amount) AS average_discount, AVG(o.subtotal) AS average_subtotal FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency

cases.question: Summarize customer counts by region identifier.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.region_id, COUNT(c.id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.region_id ORDER BY c.region_id

cases.question: For each payment status, show its smallest and largest amount.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.status, MIN(p.amount) AS minimum_amount, MAX(p.amount) AS maximum_amount FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status

cases.question: Group orders by representative and currency, then sum total amount.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.sales_rep_id, o.currency, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id, o.currency ORDER BY o.sales_rep_id, o.currency

cases.question: Calculate net order value after subtracting the discount.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.total_amount - o.discount_amount AS net_value FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: For each line, calculate quantity multiplied by unit price.
cases.reference_sql:
SELECT
oi.id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS extended_value FROM order_items AS oi ORDER BY oi.id

cases.question: Show each payment after a two percent processing deduction.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.amount - p.amount * 0.02 AS net_amount FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: Calculate the percentage of each order total represented by its discount.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, CASE WHEN o.total_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(o.discount_amount AS numeric) / o.total_amount * 100 END AS discount_share FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show each refund as a fraction of the related order total.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, CASE WHEN o.total_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(r.amount AS numeric) / o.total_amount END AS refund_fraction FROM refunds AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = r.order_id ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Calculate the gap between an order subtotal and its total.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.subtotal - o.total_amount AS subtotal_gap FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Report average unit value per quantity for each category.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, CASE WHEN SUM(oi.quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS numeric) / SUM(oi.quantity) END AS unit_value FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: Show refund amount remaining after a one percent handling deduction.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.amount - r.amount * 0.01 AS net_refund FROM refunds AS r ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: For every currency, compute total discount as a share of subtotal.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.currency, CASE WHEN SUM(o.subtotal) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(SUM(o.discount_amount) AS numeric) / SUM(o.subtotal) * 100 END AS discount_share FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency

cases.question: Calculate the average order total per customer in each representative group.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.sales_rep_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS numeric) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) END AS average_customer_value FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id ORDER BY o.sales_rep_id

cases.question: List orders whose currency code is USD.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.currency = 'USD' ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show customers assigned to region 1.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers AS c WHERE c.region_id = 1 ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: Return products in the hardware category.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.unit_price FROM products AS p WHERE p.category = 'hardware' ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: List payments greater than 250 in amount.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.amount FROM payments AS p WHERE p.amount > 250 ORDER BY p.amount

cases.question: Show refunds attached to order identifier 2.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.amount FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.order_id = 2 ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Return orders handled by sales representative 3.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.sales_rep_id = 3 ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show items with quantity at least 4.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT oi.id, oi.quantity FROM order_items AS oi WHERE oi.quantity >= 4 ORDER BY oi.id

cases.question: List the region with stable identifier 1.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name FROM regions AS r WHERE r.id = 1 ORDER BY r.name

cases.question: Show completed orders with their totals.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Return unsettled payments with their amounts.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.amount FROM payments AS p WHERE p.status <> 'settled' ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: Show USD orders whose total exceeds 200.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.currency = 'USD' AND o.total_amount > 200 ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: List products that are hardware or software.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category FROM products AS p WHERE p.category IN ('hardware', 'software') ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: Return orders that are completed or pending.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.status FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'pending') ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show payments outside the settled and failed statuses.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.status FROM payments AS p WHERE p.status NOT IN ('settled', 'failed') ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: List discounts that are positive and orders above 100.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.discount_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.discount_amount > 0 AND o.total_amount > 100 ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Find orders that are either cancelled or below 50 total.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' OR o.total_amount < 50 ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show payments with a positive amount that are not failed.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.amount FROM payments AS p WHERE p.amount > 0 AND p.status <> 'failed' ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: Return products not in the obsolete category.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category FROM products AS p WHERE NOT p.category = 'obsolete' ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: List refunds above 20 or refunds with reason customer_request.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.amount, r.reason FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.amount > 20 OR r.reason = 'customer_request' ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Show orders with a nonzero discount and USD currency.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.discount_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.discount_amount <> 0 AND o.currency = 'USD' ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Which orders carry the completed lifecycle label?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Find orders recorded in EUR.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number FROM orders AS o WHERE o.currency = 'EUR' ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Which products use the office category label?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products AS p WHERE p.category = 'office' ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: Find payments marked settled.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id FROM payments AS p WHERE p.status = 'settled' ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: Which refunds cite a damaged_item reason?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.reason = 'damaged_item' ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Find orders placed after the 2024-01-01 timestamp.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number FROM orders AS o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Which representatives belong to region identifier 2?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.name FROM sales_representatives AS sr WHERE sr.region_id = 2 ORDER BY sr.name

cases.question: Find lines whose unit price is exactly 75.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT oi.id FROM order_items AS oi WHERE oi.unit_price = 75 ORDER BY oi.id

cases.question: Which customers carry the name Ada?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers AS c WHERE c.name = 'Ada' ORDER BY c.id

cases.question: Find refunds with the duplicate_charge reason.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.amount FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.reason = 'duplicate_charge' ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Count orders by the calendar month of ordered_at.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS order_month, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) ORDER BY order_month

cases.question: Sum payment amounts by payment month.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_at) AS payment_month, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM payments AS p GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_at) ORDER BY payment_month

cases.question: List orders from the first quarter of 2024.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.ordered_at FROM orders AS o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-04-01 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY o.ordered_at

cases.question: Show refunds recorded during the 2023 calendar year.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.refunded_at FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.refunded_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2023-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND r.refunded_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY r.refunded_at

cases.question: Report average order value by ordered_at year.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_PART('year', o.ordered_at) AS order_year, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_total FROM orders AS o GROUP BY DATE_PART('year', o.ordered_at) ORDER BY order_year

cases.question: Count payments by the date on which they were paid.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT CAST(p.paid_at AS date) AS paid_date, COUNT(p.id) AS payment_count FROM payments AS p GROUP BY CAST(p.paid_at AS date) ORDER BY paid_date

cases.question: Show orders created in February 2024.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.ordered_at FROM orders AS o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-02-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-03-01 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY o.ordered_at

cases.question: Sum refunds by the month of refund completion.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', r.refunded_at) AS refund_month, SUM(r.amount) AS refund_total FROM refunds AS r GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', r.refunded_at) ORDER BY refund_month

cases.question: Find orders older than 90 days from the fixed 2024-06-01 boundary.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.ordered_at FROM orders AS o WHERE o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-06-01 00:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '90 days' ORDER BY o.ordered_at

cases.question: Show the weekday number of each order date.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, EXTRACT(DOW FROM o.ordered_at) AS weekday_number FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Number each order within its customer by newest order first.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.customer_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC) AS customer_order_number FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.customer_id, customer_order_number

cases.question: Rank products by price inside each category.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.category, price_rank

cases.question: Show a running total of order value by order date.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.ordered_at, SUM(o.total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY o.ordered_at, o.id) AS running_total FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.ordered_at, o.id

cases.question: Compare each payment with the previous payment for its order.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.amount, LAG(p.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_id ORDER BY p.paid_at, p.id) AS prior_amount FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.order_id, p.paid_at, p.id

cases.question: Show the largest order amount per customer beside every order.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.customer_id, o.total_amount, MAX(o.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS customer_maximum FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.customer_id, o.order_number

cases.question: Compute each order's share of its customer's order value.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.customer_id, CASE WHEN SUM(o.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE o.total_amount / SUM(o.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) END AS customer_share FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.customer_id, o.order_number

cases.question: Give a dense rank to representatives by total sales.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.id, sr.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sales_rank, sr.name

cases.question: Show the next order timestamp for each customer.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.customer_id, LEAD(o.ordered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at, o.id) AS next_order_at FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.customer_id, o.ordered_at

cases.question: Calculate a two-row moving average of order totals.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, AVG(o.total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY o.ordered_at, o.id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_average FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.ordered_at, o.id

cases.question: Rank refunds from largest to smallest within each reason.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.reason, r.amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.reason ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.id) AS reason_rank FROM refunds AS r ORDER BY r.reason, reason_rank

cases.question: Return one compact order projection with an explicit display label.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number AS order_label, o.status AS lifecycle_status FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show product name and a computed price including a fixed fee.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.unit_price + 5 AS price_with_fee FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.name

cases.question: Return only the identifier and name for each region.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name FROM regions AS r ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Project customer name with its representative identifier.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, c.sales_rep_id AS representative_id FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: Show payment status and amount as the two result columns.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.status, p.amount FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.id

cases.question: Return refund reason and amount under readable aliases.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.reason AS refund_reason, r.amount AS refund_amount FROM refunds AS r ORDER BY r.id

cases.question: Project each line's quantity and unit price without aggregation.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT oi.quantity, oi.unit_price FROM order_items AS oi ORDER BY oi.id

cases.question: Return order number plus a boolean indicating a discount.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, (o.discount_amount > 0) AS has_discount FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show category and product count as a grouped two-column result.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: Return each order number and ordered date only.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.ordered_at FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number

cases.question: Show the three orders with the greatest total amount.
cases.reference_sql:
SELECT
o.order_number, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Return five products in alphabetical name order.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: List the four largest payments.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.id, p.amount FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.amount DESC LIMIT 4

cases.question: Show the two most valuable refunds.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.id, r.amount FROM refunds AS r ORDER BY r.amount DESC LIMIT 2

cases.question: Return the first six customers by name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, c.region_id FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 6

cases.question: Show product categories ordered by average price, highest first.
cases.reference_sql:
SELECT
p.category, AVG(p.unit_price) AS average_price FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY average_price DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Find the top five representatives by number of orders.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: List the three earliest orders by their timestamp.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_number, o.ordered_at FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.ordered_at ASC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Show the bottom four products by unit price.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, p.unit_price FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.unit_price ASC LIMIT 4

cases.question: Return the two payment statuses with the highest totals.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.status, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY payment_total DESC LIMIT 2

cases.question: List the distinct currencies used by orders.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.currency FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.currency

cases.question: Return unique payment statuses.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.status FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.status

cases.question: Count distinct customers represented in each region.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.region_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.region_id ORDER BY c.region_id

cases.question: Count distinct products ordered by each customer.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.customer_id

cases.question: Show distinct refund reasons and their counts.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.reason, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS refund_count FROM refunds AS r GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY r.reason

cases.question: Count distinct orders for every sales representative.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.sales_rep_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id ORDER BY o.sales_rep_id

cases.question: List unique product categories with their product totals.
cases.reference_sql:
SELECT
p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS product_count FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: Count distinct orders having a payment in each status.
cases.reference_sql:
SELECT
p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS order_count FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status

cases.question: List customer identifiers appearing in orders without duplicates.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.customer_id

cases.question: Show unique order currencies with the number of orders using each.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.currency, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency
